# RNA DATA
Raw GENCODE v47 RNA-seq count and log2-transformed matrices are imported and used to define the 890 sequenced samples. Batch 1 and Batch 2 RNA manifests are harmonized, combined, and restricted to inventory codes present in the RNA-seq matrices, reflecting samples retained after RNA-seq quality control. Timepoint codes (T0–T3) are recoded to ED, 2-week (2WK), and 6-month (M6) labels, and participant-level sets with RNA-seq data at each visit (ED, 2WK, M6) are derived from the unified manifest.

## Data prep
```{r}
# load in RNA counts 
AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_counts <- read_csv("Data/RNA Data/Data Files/AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_counts.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
dim(AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_counts) # 890 19906
range(AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_counts[, 3:ncol(AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_counts)]) # 0 663281

# load in log2 transformed RNA seq 
AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_log2   <- read_csv("Data/RNA Data/Data Files/AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_log2.csv",   show_col_types = FALSE)
dim(AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_log2) # 890 19906
range(AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_log2[, 3:ncol(AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_log2)]) # 0.00000 19.33926

# pull out the unique inventory codes from RNA counts 
RNA_inventory_codes <- AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_counts$INVENTORY.CODE %>% unique()
length(RNA_inventory_codes) # 890 RNA samples 

RNA_manifest_batch1 <- read_csv("Data/RNA Data/Data Files/AURORA_RNA_Expression_Manifest_Batch1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(Batch = 1) %>%
  dplyr::rename(INVENTORY.CODE = `INVENTORY CODE`, ALT.ID = `ALT ID`)
dim(RNA_manifest_batch1) # 600 RNA samples, 6 columns 
  
RNA_manifest_batch2 <- read_csv("Data/RNA Data/Data Files/AURORA_RNA_Expression_Manifest_Batch2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(Batch = 2) %>%
  dplyr::rename(INVENTORY.CODE = External_Code, ALT.ID = `ALT ID`)
dim(RNA_manifest_batch2) # 382 RNA samples, 11 columns 

# 600 + 382 = 982 ... this is how many RNA samples there were before the RNA seq data was cleaned/filtered. After cleaning there were only 890 samples left (what we see in the RNA-seq matrices)

RNA_manifest <- bind_rows(
  RNA_manifest_batch1 %>% dplyr::select(PID, INVENTORY.CODE, ALT.ID, Batch),
  RNA_manifest_batch2 %>% dplyr::select(PID, INVENTORY.CODE, ALT.ID, Batch)) %>%
  filter(INVENTORY.CODE %in% RNA_inventory_codes) %>%
  mutate(
  ALT.ID = case_when(
  ALT.ID == "T0" ~ "ED",
  ALT.ID == "T1" ~ "WK2",
  ALT.ID %in% c("T2", "T3") ~ "M6",
  TRUE ~ ALT.ID),
  Timepoint = factor(ALT.ID, levels = c("ED", "WK2", "M6"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, INVENTORY.CODE, Timepoint, Batch) %>%
   mutate(PID = as.character(PID))


dim(RNA_manifest) #890 x 4 

RNA_pids <- RNA_manifest %>% pull(PID) %>% unique()
length(RNA_pids) # 507 participants with samples 

ED_pids  <- RNA_manifest %>% filter(Timepoint == "ED")  %>% 
  pull(PID) %>%   
  unique()

WK2_pids <- RNA_manifest %>% filter(Timepoint == "WK2") %>% 
  pull(PID) %>% 
  unique()

M6_pids  <- RNA_manifest %>% filter(Timepoint == "M6")  %>% 
  pull(PID) %>% 
  unique()

length(ED_pids) # 419 participants with ED samples 
length(WK2_pids) # 141 participants with 2WK samples 
length(M6_pids) # 330 participants with M6 samples 

AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_counts_clean <- AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_counts %>%
  left_join(RNA_manifest[, 1:2], by = "INVENTORY.CODE") %>%
  dplyr::select(-...1) %>%
  dplyr::select(INVENTORY.CODE, PID, everything())

dim(AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_counts_clean) # 890 x 19906

AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_log2_clean <- AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_log2 %>%
  dplyr::rename(INVENTORY.CODE = X) %>%
  dplyr::select(-...1) %>%
  left_join(RNA_manifest[, 1:2], by = "INVENTORY.CODE") %>%
  dplyr::select(INVENTORY.CODE, PID, everything())

dim(AURORA_RNA_Seq_V47_log2_clean) # 890 x 19906

```

## Determine ED–M6 and ED–2WK–M6 RNA-seq cohorts
RNA-seq timepoint availability is summarized per participant, and PID sets are defined for those with paired ED–M6 data and those with complete ED–2WK–M6 coverage.
```{r}
# wide manifest: each PID gets one row with ED/WK2/M6 inventory codes
RNA_manifest_wide <- RNA_manifest %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, INVENTORY.CODE, Timepoint) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Timepoint,
    values_from = INVENTORY.CODE,
    names_prefix = "InvCode_")

# per-timepoint flags for presence of each RNA-seq timepoint
timepoints_flags <- RNA_manifest %>%
group_by(PID) %>%
summarize(
has_ED  = any(Timepoint == "ED"),
has_WK2 = any(Timepoint == "WK2"),
has_M6  = any(Timepoint == "M6"),
.groups = "drop")

# PIDs paired ED and M6 samples 
ED_M6_paired_PIDs <- timepoints_flags %>%
filter(has_ED & has_M6) %>%
pull(PID)

ED_M6_inventory_codes <- RNA_manifest_wide %>%
  filter(PID %in% ED_M6_paired_PIDs) %>%
  dplyr::select(InvCode_ED, InvCode_M6) %>%
  unlist(use.names = FALSE)

length(ED_M6_paired_PIDs)  # 253 participants with paired ED and M6 RNA-seq
length(ED_M6_inventory_codes) # 506 paired samples 

# PIDs with ED, 2WK, and M6 RNA samples
ED_WK2_M6_paired_PIDs <- timepoints_flags %>%
filter(has_ED & has_WK2 & has_M6) %>%
pull(PID)

ED_WK2_M6_inventory_codes <- RNA_manifest_wide %>%
  filter(PID %in% ED_WK2_M6_paired_PIDs) %>%
  dplyr::select(InvCode_ED, InvCode_M6) %>%
  unlist(use.names = FALSE)

length(ED_WK2_M6_paired_PIDs)  # 44 participants with ED, 2WK, and M6 RNA-seq
length(ED_WK2_M6_inventory_codes) # 88 paired samples 

```
